question: Rescaled-range analysis gives a Hurst exponent of about 0.22 for one series and about 0.77 for the other. Which statement matches the charts?
options: P has H ≈ 0.77: persistent, so it suits trend-following; Q has H ≈ 0.22: anti-persistent
P has H ≈ 0.22: anti-persistent (mean-reverting); Q has H ≈ 0.77: persistent, suiting trend-following
Q has H ≈ 0.22; an exponent below 0.5 indicates persistence, so Q suits trend-following
Q has H ≈ 0.77; an exponent above 0.5 means moves tend to reverse, so Q suits mean-reversion
